name: Mewburn Ellis LLP
summary: Mewburn Ellis LLP commits to integrating environmental, labour, and human rights considerations into procurement to promote sustainable, ethical, and responsible sourcing. The policy emphasizes supplier standards, staff training, annual monitoring, and continuous improvement to reduce environmental impact and strengthen supply chain responsibility.
tagline: Sourcing responsibly for a more sustainable future.

declaration.preface: Mewburn Ellis LLP is committed to minimising the impact of its activities on the environment by implementing sustainable practices, reducing waste and energy consumption, and promoting eco-friendly initiatives. We are committed to continuous improvement, compliance with environmental regulations, and fostering environmental awareness among employees and stakeholders.
declaration.declaration: Our environmental policy aims to identify the firm’s impact on the environment and to continually improve in its environmental performance.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all operating sites where Mewburn Ellis conducts its business activities, covering all employees (whether permanent, fixed term or temporary), contractors, stakeholders, and third-party partners engaged in our operations.

Energy: Achieving greater energy efficiency involves implementing LED lighting and energy-efficient HVAC systems across all Mewburn Ellis facilities where practical.
Increasing reliance on renewable energy and working with landlords to move to more renewable options.

Employee training on energy-saving practices through our internal communications channels includes efficient equipment use, lighting controls, and the importance of reducing energy consumption during peak hours at Mewburn Ellis.

When we move buildings e.g. at the end of a tenancy, energy efficiency to meet these aims will be a key factor when looking at new buildings – specifically we will look for buildings with high EPC and BREAM ratings to minimize the carbon footprint of any new offices.
Green House Gases (GHG): Reducing greenhouse gas emissions involves promoting sustainable or active travel to our offices including through a cycle to work scheme, providing the opportunity to purchase electric or plug in hybrid models using our electric car scheme, and promoting remote work options to reduce commuting.

Increasing energy efficiency in buildings by suggesting to landlords to consider options available such as retrofitting insulation and windows to reduce heating and cooling demands, thereby lowering GHG emissions.
Pushing our landlords to adopt renewable energy sources like solar panels on office rooftops and purchasing green energy certificates helps to decrease Mewburn Ellis' reliance on fossil fuels.
Waste Management: Enhancing waste reduction efforts includes encouraging employees to use reusable containers and utensils in the office kitchen and cafeteria.
Optimizing waste segregation practices entails providing clear signage and designated bins for different types of recyclable and non-recyclable waste.
Implementing electronic waste (e-waste) recycling programs involves partnering with certified recyclers to dispose of old computers, monitors, and other electronic devices responsibly.

targets.target: Increase the use of renewable energy sources to 85% of total energy consumption
Achieve a 56% reduction in scope 1 emissions
Achieve a 20% reduction in scope 2 emissions
Achieve a 22% reduction in scope 3 emissions
Achieve a 90% reduction and net-zero in scope 1,2 & 3 emissions
Remove at least 10% of our CO2e use each year following the Oxford Offsetting Principles
Achieve 50% participation in proper waste segregation and recycling practices

Participating actively in energy-saving practices and waste reduction efforts.
Following recycling guidelines and properly disposing of electronic waste.
Reading material provided on environmental awareness and sustainability practices.
Reporting any environmental concerns or opportunities for improvement to their supervisors.
Providing leadership and support for the implementation of the Environmental Policy.
Allocating resources for energy-efficient equipment and renewable energy initiatives.
Monitoring and evaluating the progress of environmental targets and initiatives.
Ensuring compliance with environmental regulations and standards.
Monitoring regulatory changes and ensuring compliance with environmental laws.
Advising on environmental risk management and mitigation strategies.
Providing guidance on legal aspects related to environmental impact assessments and audits.
Integrating environmental awareness and sustainability into employee training and development programs.
Promoting a culture of environmental responsibility through communication and engagement initiatives.
Facilitating employee participation in environmental activities and programs.
Supporting management in ensuring that environmental considerations are included in job roles and performance evaluations.

policy.monitoring:
Transparent and regular reporting mechanisms are essential for tracking progress, identifying areas for improvement, and maintaining accountability. Mewburn Ellis LLP implements the following reporting procedures:

Regular Environmental Performance Reports: We conduct annual assessments of our environmental performance, compiling data on key indicators outlined in our Environmental Policy.

Internal Audits: Internal audits are conducted to evaluate compliance with environmental regulations, assess the effectiveness of environmental management systems, and identify areas for corrective action.

Stakeholder Engagement: We engage with stakeholders, including employees, customers, regulators, and communities, to gather feedback, address concerns, and communicate our environmental performance and initiatives transparently.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Sustainability Champion and Chief Commercial Officer at Mewburn Ellis LLP will review the Environmental Policy annually, and any updates will be communicated as necessary.
